q: Which statement correctly distinguishes RAM from storage?
options: RAM permanently stores files when power is off
RAM is working memory; storage retains files
why: RAM is temporary working memory used by running processes. Storage retains files when the computer is powered off.

q: A relative path is interpreted from which location?
why: A relative path is resolved from the process or tool's current working directory.

q: Why should a raw source dataset be kept separate from a working copy?
options: To preserve an unchanged reference and allow transformations to be audited
Because CSV files cannot be copied
why: An unchanged source supports reproducibility and recovery if a transformation is incorrect.

q: Which statement about synchronization is most accurate?
options: It is always a complete backup
It may replicate deletion or corruption, so independent versioned backups are important
why: Synchronization mirrors changes. A separate recoverable backup with history is needed.

q: What should you do before running an unfamiliar recursive deletion command?
options: Paste it into the project folder
Understand the command, inspect the target path and test only on disposable data
why: Destructive commands can permanently remove data. Verify the command and target before execution.
